name: Soy-Paper Sushi Rolls (Salmon Avocado or Shrimp Tempura)
whyItWorks: Swapping dark green nori seaweed for soy paper eliminates the tough wrapper that can catch on inflamed tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with soy paper and no sesame seeds. Safe fillings: salmon, tuna, cooked crab stick (kanikama), steamed shrimp, and smooth avocado. Skip raw cucumber sticks, jalapeno, or roe.
